hypothesis: Factorized input gain may improve optimization and generalization to held-out ECG recordings; this does not add independent linear capacity or establish a timing-specific or novel mechanism.
prior_art: Static channel scaling/factorized linear parameters are established; this is an empirical transfer hypothesis.
matched_control: Fresh current-source two-layer SE-adLIF; same split, batch, precision, loss, dropout, optimizer, learning rate, stopping and budget. No historical ECG control or calibration weights reused.
initialization: Fresh random weights and fresh Adam state, epoch0, training seed42; disposable calibration seed117states have been discarded.
input: All1301timesteps and4channels, original negative end-marker inputs. Gain applies inside the model; no raw data/label/mask alteration or truncation.
loss: summed_membrane_potentials on original per-timestep blocks; original argmax labels and dummy ignored target preserved
primary_metric: Clean validation accuracy per labeled timestep; select checkpoints by validation accuracy only
supporting_diagnostics: Ordinary validation CE, full learning curves and post-screen class-sensitive validation diagnostics; correlated timesteps are not independent records.
advancement_rule: Review whether the matched baseline learns adequately. Extend both arms50->100only when improvement/remaining learning or genuine inconclusiveness justifies it. Do not fully train every candidate;400is reserved for the later frozen comparison. No test-driven selection or heavy B investment before transfer review.
estimated_wall_time: About20-25minutes for both50epoch arms including startup/checkpoint overhead; estimate from calibration, not a guarantee.
portability_preflight: Both2arm dry runs passed from repository root and unrelated working directory; resolved dataset/artifact paths remain repository-relative in persisted configs.
SSC_context: A002 SSC40nominal+0.10019pp was below the practical+0.5pp threshold; preserve it as weak single-seed validation evidence, not broad improvement.
